---
title: "Excitation-Inhibition Balance Tuning via tvboptim"
---

Reproducing the FIC+EIB tuning workflow from [Schirner et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38626-y). Fits local inhibitory weights (J_i) for E-I balance and dual coupling weights (wLRE, wFFI) to match empirical functional connectivity.

```{python}
# | output: false
import os

os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=8"

from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
from tvboptim.data import load_structural_connectivity, load_functional_connectivity
from tvboptim.observations.observation import fc_corr, rmse, compute_fc
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import jax.numpy as jnp

# Load experiment and network
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file(
    "/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/database/experiments/EI_Tuning_FIC_EIB_Optimization.yaml"
)

results = exp.run("tvboptim", mode="all")


```

## Results

```{python}
#| label: fig-ei-tuning-results
#| fig-cap: "**EI Tuning Results.** (A) S_e before FIC. (B) S_e after FIC. (C) FIC convergence. (D) J_i distribution. (E-G) FC matrices: target, post-FIC, post-EIB. (H) EIB convergence. (I) wLRE weights."
#| fig-height: 12

cmap = plt.cm.cividis
accent_blue = cmap(0.3)
accent_gold = cmap(0.85)
accent_mid = cmap(0.6)

mosaic = """
AABBCC
DDEEFF
GGHHII
"""
fig, axes = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic, figsize=(12, 10))

# A: S_e Before FIC
ax = axes["A"]
data = results.fic.pre_tuning.data[:, 0, :]
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="A. Before FIC")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend()

# B: S_e After FIC
ax = axes["B"]
data = fic_results.post_tuning.data[:, 0, :]
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="B. After FIC")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend()

# C: FIC Convergence
ax = axes["C"]
ax.plot(fic_results.history.mean_S_e, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='Mean S_e')
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="FIC iteration", ylabel="Mean S_e", title="C. FIC Convergence")
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# D: J_i Distribution
ax = axes["D"]
J_i = np.array(fic_results.state.dynamics.J_i).flatten()
ax.bar(range(len(J_i)), J_i, alpha=0.7, color=accent_mid)
ax.set(xlabel="Region", ylabel="J_i", title="D. Inhibitory Weights (J_i)")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# E: Target FC
ax = axes["E"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_target)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=0, vmax=0.9)
ax.set(title="E. Target FC")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# F: Post-FIC FC
ax = axes["F"]
fc_plot = np.copy(np.array(fc_post_fic))
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
corr_fic = fc_corr(fc_post_fic, fc_target)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=0, vmax=0.9)
ax.set(title=f"F. Post-FIC FC (r={corr_fic:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# G: Post-EIB FC
ax = axes["G"]
fc_plot = np.copy(np.array(fc_post_eib))
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
corr_eib = fc_corr(fc_post_eib, fc_target)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=0, vmax=0.9)
ax.set(title=f"G. Post-EIB FC (r={corr_eib:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# H: EIB Convergence (FC correlation and RMSE)
ax = axes["H"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
fc_corrs = np.array(fic_eib_results.history.fc_corr)
fc_rmses = np.array(fic_eib_results.history.rmse_fc)
l1, = ax.plot(fc_corrs, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='FC Corr')
l2, = ax2.plot(fc_rmses, lw=2, color=accent_gold, label='FC RMSE')
ax.set(xlabel="EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="H. EIB Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc='center right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# I: wLRE Weights
ax = axes["I"]
wLRE = np.array(fic_eib_results.state.coupling.coupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE, cmap='cividis')
wLRE_corr = np.corrcoef(wLRE.flatten(), fc_target.flatten())[0, 1]
ax.set(title=f"I. wLRE (r={wLRE_corr:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(f"\n=== EI Tuning Summary ===")
print(f"FIC: Mean S_e = {fic_results.history.mean_S_e[-1]:.4f} (target: 0.25)")
print(f"Post-FIC FC correlation: {corr_fic:.4f}")
print(f"Post-EIB FC correlation: {corr_eib:.4f}")
print(f"Improvement: Δr = {corr_eib - corr_fic:+.4f}")
```
